keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Ben Bender (Philadelphia Union).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Jovan Lukic (Philadelphia Union).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, FC Cincinnati 0, Philadelphia Union 0.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Evander replaces Samuel Gidi.
Second Half begins FC Cincinnati 0, Philadelphia Union 0.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Jesús Bueno replaces Ben Bender.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Cavan Sullivan replaces Ezekiel Alladoh.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Ender Echenique replaces Kenji Mboma Dem.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Ayoub Jabbari replaces Tom Barlow.
Goal! FC Cincinnati 1, Philadelphia Union 0. Ayoub Jabbari (FC Cincinnati) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Agustín Anello replaces Indiana Vassilev.
Delay in match because of an injury Nathan Harriel (Philadelphia Union).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Teenage Hadebe (FC Cincinnati).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Alvas Powell replaces Teenage Hadebe because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Nick Hagglund (FC Cincinnati).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Tah Brian Anunga replaces Kévin Denkey.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Malik Jakupovic replaces Jovan Lukic.
